Downtown Las Cruces.name: Downtown Las Cruces
Downtown Las Cruces.description: Main Street downtown corridor with the historic Plaza, the Rio Grande Theatre, and mixed-use redevelopment of the commercial core.

Las Cruces Plaza.name: Las Cruces Plaza
Las Cruces Plaza.description: Historic Plaza district with the Doña Ana County Courthouse, the Cathedral of the Immaculate Heart of Mary, and century-old storefront retail.

Mesilla Historic District.name: Mesilla Historic District
Mesilla Historic District.description: Historic Mesilla town square with adobe architecture, the Basilica of San Albino, and a tourist-oriented arts and dining economy.

NMSU Corridor.name: NMSU Corridor
NMSU Corridor.description: New Mexico State University corridor with student housing, tech-transfer spin-offs, and the Arrowhead Research Park.

East Mesa Growth.name: East Mesa Growth
East Mesa Growth.description: Eastern growth corridor along Lohman Avenue with new subdivisions, strip retail, and the expanding Las Cruces airport edge.

Sonoma Ranch.name: Sonoma Ranch
Sonoma Ranch.description: Northwest master-planned community with golf-course residential, Sonoma Ranch Elementary, and the emerging Sonoma Marketplace retail.

Telshor/Medical District.name: Telshor/Medical District
Telshor/Medical District.description: Telshor Boulevard medical corridor with Memorial Medical Center, MountainView Regional, and the highest concentration of medical office and ancillary services.

Las Colinas.name: Las Colinas
Las Colinas.description: Northern residential area with Mesilla Valley Hospital, established neighborhoods, and the Foothills Road corridor.

West Mesa.name: West Mesa
West Mesa.description: West side of the Rio Grande valley with agricultural land, rural residential, and the Doña Ana County Government Center.
